Class CraftTweakerMolecules.Definition

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerMolecules.Definition
Enclosing class:
CraftTweakerMolecules
public static final class CraftTweakerMolecules.Definition extends Object
Fluent ZenScript definition. Values are snapshotted when registering, so later authoring cannot mutate an action. Common methods cover everyday models; field(String, String) exposes the entire public schema.

    • field

      public CraftTweakerMolecules.Definition field(String key, String jsonValue)
      Sets any public definition field using one JSON value. Unknown fields fail shared validation at registration. This enables atomic overrides, crystal cells, polymers, networks, constraints, edits and assembly recipes.
      Parameters:
      key - exact public schema field
      jsonValue - JSON object, array, number, boolean or quoted string
      Returns:
      this definition
